reviews.title: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Chandrakant the amazing
reviews.body:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Chandrakant – genuinely exceptional customer service

I very rarely feel compelled to write a glowing review immediately after dealing with customer service, but Chandrakant absolutely deserves one.

I was travelling in Morocco and had been having an incredibly frustrating problem with a Lebara Travel eSIM. A purchase had become associated with an incorrect email address, I couldn’t access the eSIM, and the system then appeared to prevent me from simply buying another one. After several attempts to sort it myself, I was thoroughly fed up.

Then I got through to Chandrakant.

What a difference one excellent member of staff can make.

He listened, actually understood what had gone wrong, checked the system rather than simply sending me around in circles, and stayed with me while we worked through it. He identified the Travel eSIM on my phone, guided me through the correct settings and waited while I switched off Wi-Fi to make absolutely certain the mobile data was genuinely working.

It worked.

Better still, he then dealt with the refund for the unusable purchase and explained clearly when I should receive confirmation and when the money should be returned.

Throughout the conversation he was patient, polite, reassuring and — most importantly — effective. I started the chat extremely frustrated and finished it genuinely delighted. That is quite an achievement!

Customer service is easy when nothing has gone wrong. The real test is what happens when a customer has a complicated problem and needs someone to take ownership of it. Chandrakant did exactly that.

Lebara, please make sure this feedback reaches him and his manager. People who provide customer service at this level deserve to be recognised.

Thank you, Chandrakant. You rescued my afternoon — and my internet connection in Morocco! ❤️

An absolutely deserved five stars
